description: Empirical calibration of the signal-peptide and TM scans against human reference proteomes, with ADIRF's percentile and likelihood ratio
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, re
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score, roc_curve
ADIRF="MASKGLQDLKQQVEGTAQEAVSAAGAAAQQVVDQATEAGQKAMDQLAKTTQETIDKTANQASDTFSGIGKKFGLLK"
kd=dict(A=1.8,R=-4.5,N=-3.5,D=-3.5,C=2.5,Q=-3.5,E=-3.5,G=-0.4,H=-3.2,I=4.5,L=3.8,K=-3.9,M=1.9,F=2.8,P=-1.6,S=-0.8,T=-0.7,W=-0.9,Y=-1.3,V=4.2)
U="https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search"
def grab(q,n=400):
    out=[];cur=None
    r=requests.get(U,params={"query":q,"format":"json","size":500,"fields":"accession,sequence,length"},timeout=180)
    return r.json()["results"][:n]
# empirical reference sets: human reviewed proteins WITH vs WITHOUT an annotated signal peptide
pos=grab('(organism_id:9606) AND (reviewed:true) AND (ft_signal:*) AND (length:[60 TO 400]) AND (existence:1)')
neg=grab('(organism_id:9606) AND (reviewed:true) AND NOT (ft_signal:*) AND NOT (ft_transmem:*) AND (length:[60 TO 400]) AND (existence:1)')
print("reference set sizes: with signal peptide", len(pos), "| without SP and without TM", len(neg))
def h_region(s):
    seg=s[1:31]
    return max(np.mean([kd.get(a,0) for a in seg[i:i+8]]) for i in range(len(seg)-7))
def kd19(s):
    return max(np.mean([kd.get(a,0) for a in s[i:i+19]]) for i in range(len(s)-18))
P=[h_region(e["sequence"]["value"]) for e in pos]
N=[h_region(e["sequence"]["value"]) for e in neg]
y=np.r_[np.ones(len(P)),np.zeros(len(N))]; x=np.r_[P,N]
auc=roc_auc_score(y,x)
a=h_region(ADIRF)
print(f"\nSignal-peptide h-region score: ROC AUC of this metric = {auc:.3f} (n={len(P)} positives, {len(N)} negatives)")
print(f"  mean score, signal-peptide proteins: {np.mean(P):.2f} (sd {np.std(P):.2f})")
print(f"  mean score, no-SP/no-TM proteins:    {np.mean(N):.2f} (sd {np.std(N):.2f})")
print(f"  ADIRF score = {a:.2f}")
print(f"  percentile of ADIRF within signal-peptide proteins: {100*np.mean(np.array(P)<=a):.1f}%  "
      f"(i.e. {100*np.mean(np.array(P)>a):.1f}% of real signal peptides score higher)")
print(f"  percentile of ADIRF within no-SP proteins:          {100*np.mean(np.array(N)<=a):.1f}%")
# likelihood ratio at ADIRF's score using Gaussian KDE
from scipy.stats import gaussian_kde
kp,kn=gaussian_kde(P),gaussian_kde(N)
print(f"  density likelihood ratio LR(SP vs no-SP) at ADIRF's score = {float(kp(a)/kn(a)):.2f} "
      f"(LR<1 favours 'no signal peptide')")
# TM
tm=grab('(organism_id:9606) AND (reviewed:true) AND (ft_transmem:*) AND (length:[60 TO 400]) AND (existence:1)')
T=[kd19(e["sequence"]["value"]) for e in tm]
Nt=[kd19(e["sequence"]["value"]) for e in neg]
t=kd19(ADIRF)
print(f"\nTM scan (max KD window 19): ROC AUC = {roc_auc_score(np.r_[np.ones(len(T)),np.zeros(len(Nt))],np.r_[T,Nt]):.3f} (n={len(T)} TM proteins)")
print(f"  mean TM proteins {np.mean(T):.2f}; mean non-TM {np.mean(Nt):.2f}; ADIRF {t:.2f}")
print(f"  fraction of TM proteins scoring below ADIRF: {100*np.mean(np.array(T)<t):.1f}%")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,5))
bins=np.linspace(-2,4.5,45)
ax[0].hist(N,bins=bins,alpha=.6,color='#718096',label=f'human proteins without SP/TM (n={len(N)})',density=True)
ax[0].hist(P,bins=bins,alpha=.6,color='#2b6cb0',label=f'human proteins with an annotated signal peptide (n={len(P)})',density=True)
ax[0].axvline(a,color='#dd6b20',lw=3); ax[0].text(a+0.08,ax[0].get_ylim()[1]*0.85,f'ADIRF\n{a:.2f}',color='#dd6b20',fontsize=10,fontweight='bold')
ax[0].set_xlabel('best 8-residue hydrophobic-core score, residues 2-30')
ax[0].set_ylabel('density'); ax[0].legend(fontsize=8)
ax[0].set_title(f'ADIRF has no signal-peptide hydrophobic core\n(metric AUC {auc:.2f}; {100*np.mean(np.array(P)>a):.0f}% of real signal peptides score higher)',fontsize=11)
bins2=np.linspace(-2,4.5,45)
ax[1].hist(Nt,bins=bins2,alpha=.6,color='#718096',label=f'no TM annotated (n={len(Nt)})',density=True)
ax[1].hist(T,bins=bins2,alpha=.6,color='#2f855a',label=f'TM proteins (n={len(T)})',density=True)
ax[1].axvline(t,color='#dd6b20',lw=3); ax[1].text(t+0.08,ax[1].get_ylim()[1]*0.85,f'ADIRF\n{t:.2f}',color='#dd6b20',fontsize=10,fontweight='bold')
ax[1].set_xlabel('maximum Kyte-Doolittle score, window 19'); ax[1].set_ylabel('density'); ax[1].legend(fontsize=8)
ax[1].set_title('ADIRF has no transmembrane segment',fontsize=11)
for q in ax: q.grid(alpha=.25)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
pd.DataFrame(dict(score=np.r_[P,N,T],label=["SP"]*len(P)+["noSP_noTM"]*len(N)+["TM_kd19"]*len(T))).to_csv(
  "/agent/jobs/7101df4b-f637-4c64-a448-cb0dfb4eb46e/provenance/adirf_sp_tm_reference_distributions.csv",index=False)
